messages:
jamie: Heads-up — scheduled migration/backfill tonight for users.profile_picture_hash. Window 23:20-23:40 PST, holdpoint at 23:25 for lock-owner handoff. Migration id mig-2026-0421-users-backfill. Please ack if you're on-call or owning a shard.

deploy-bot: Migration job queued: mig-2026-0421-users-backfill, estimated rows=12,000,000, batch_size=10000, canary=1%, expected runtime ~45m. Logs will stream to ops-logs.

lee: ack. I'll be oncall from 23:15. I'll watch lock_waits and replica lag. If I see sustained lock waits I'll throttle IO or pause. @maria fyi.

maria: ack. Plan: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN profile_picture_hash text BEFORE backfill (no backfill in DDL), then run chunked UPDATE backfill. App will be feature-flag guarded.

sasha: one concern — the UPDATE backfill churns WAL and can spike replica lag. We should use small chunks + pauses. Consider switching to a copy-then-swap approach if lag gets bad.

jamie: agreed. Backfill uses chunked updates with savepoints: `WHERE id > $last_id LIMIT 10000`, pause after each 200k rows for replicas. Config in ops repo: https://ops.redwood/migrations/mig-2026-0421.

lee: abort criteria: if lock_waits > 5s for more than 60s OR replica lag > 30s for >2min, we abort to fallback (leave column null, app reads null-safe). Rollback plan documented.

maria: confirmed app pinned to commit `release/2026-04-21-mig` and feature-flag `profile-hash-enabled` default=false. If we abort we keep feature-flag off.

deploy-bot: mig-2026-0421-users-backfill started (canary). Initial logs: `rows_processed=10000` `avg_row_time=0.002s`.

jamie: monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/mig-2026-0421. Lee please call out if you need immediate pause. Escape hatch: `deploy-bot cancel mig-2026-0421-users-backfill` then run rollback commands in runbook.

lee: Spotted a brief lock spike to 12s at 23:28, paused job at 23:29 and increased backoff. Holding at the 23:25 holdpoint now.

maria: I'm reducing batch_size -> 2000 and will resume canary at 0.5% to validate impact.

jamie: go ahead. Everyone react :eyes: once you've seen the hold and new params. Note we pinned the migration to DB cluster `redwood-prod-03` to avoid cross-region effects.

sasha: :thumbsup: go ahead.

deploy-bot: mig-2026-0421-users-backfill resumed (batch_size=2000, canary=0.5%).

lee: monitoring — current avg lock_wait 1.2s, replica lag stable ~6s. No abort.

jamie: if we reach 30% processed with stable metrics we move to 10% ramp, otherwise fallback.

maria: noted. Preparing TTL cleanup job to run 2 hours after backfill completion.

jamie: rollback commands in runbook: `psql -c "ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN profile_picture_hash;"` and app rollback `kubectl rollout undo deploy/web --to-revision=<previous>`. Also have `deploy-bot create rollback-ticket mig-2026-0421` available.

lee: staying until 00:30 PST. Will escalate immediately if thresholds hit.

sasha: I'm on standby for manual sharding or changing chunking strategy.

deploy-bot: mig-2026-0421-users-backfill canary finished: rows=120000, time=18s, avg_row_time=0.0015s.

jamie: moving to 10% ramp in 5m and running quick QA sweep before full rollout.

maria: QA passed for canary. Ok to proceed to full rollout per the rollout policy.

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% started for mig-2026-0421-users-backfill.

jamie: Completed rollout. Closing thread. Thanks all — documented notes + timeline in ops-runbook. :tada:
